statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-39883 affects the BSD kenv command invocation in OpenTelemetry's host resource detection. The kenv command is specific to FreeBSD/macOS and does not exist on Linux. The aws-node-termination-handler image runs exclusively in Linux containers, so the vulnerable code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-39883 affects the BSD kenv command invocation in OpenTelemetry's host resource detection. The kenv command is specific to FreeBSD/macOS and does not exist on Linux. The aws-node-termination-handler image runs exclusively in Linux containers, so the vulnerable code path is never executed.

The vulnerable hostIDReaderBSD.read() function that invokes kenv is only compiled on BSD targets (//go:build dragonfly || freebsd || netbsd || openbsd || solaris). On Linux the hostIDReaderLinux implementation is compiled instead, which reads /etc/machine-id directly with no shell invocation. dapr-scheduler targets linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 only; the BSD code path is never present in the built binary.
